webster.text: Fast fixed; firm; firmly fixed or established; as the stedfast globe of earth.

more.text: Constant; firm; resolute; not fickle or wavering.

example.quote: Had he continued steadfast to those principles in religion and government, which, in his former life, he professed, and which alone had procured him the confidence of the people and all his importance, he would have lived and died, respected and beloved, and have done honor to his native country.
